title: When dishonest gain takes the roots with it
odia: ଅଧର୍ମ ବିତ୍ତ ବଢେ ବହୁତ, ଗଲା ବେଳେ ଯାଏ ମୂଳ ସହିତ ।
literal_meaning: Wrongfully gained wealth grows greatly, but disappears with its roots.
explanation: The image contrasts rapid growth with loss at the root. Wealth obtained dishonestly may look impressive, yet the conduct behind it can endanger the whole household or enterprise. This is a moral warning about how gain is obtained, not a reliable prediction that every dishonest person will become poor.
meaning_odia: ଅସତ୍ ଉପାୟରେ ଅର୍ଜିତ ଧନ ଶେଷରେ ସବୁ କିଛି ହରାଇବାର କାରଣ ହୋଇପାରେ।
usage_example: A trader is tempted to falsify weights for a little extra profit. An older colleague uses the saying to warn that losing customers’ trust could destroy the business. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The rhyme of ବହୁତ and ସହିତ gives the warning a memorable close. The root image suggests losing the foundation, not merely the most recent gain. A version appears as the opening proverb of the1893 collection.
